corpus_stability.reason: The California Driver's Handbook is a stable annual issuer publication, so Section Two permit facts change at most once per year.

ranked.label: Five permit steps: apply, document, pay, knowledge test, vision test
Teen clocks: fifteen and a half to permit, sixteen to license, six months, fifty hours
Provisional bans: late nights, young passengers, paid driving
Every exception needs a signed note in the car
Four proofs open the application: identity, residency twice, name, social security
Practice only with a licensed adult close enough to grab control

sections.heading: C - California Driver's Handbook Section Two: Getting a Permit and License
sections.markdown:
## C - California Driver's Handbook Section Two: Getting a Permit and License

FACT_ID: sec02-F01 | anchor: A01
Without a license from California or another state, you must hold an instruction permit before you may take the behind-the-wheel drive test [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec02-F02 | anchor: A01
A permit or license application must include proof of identity showing who you are [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec02-F03 | anchor: A01
You must also show two proofs that you live in California, though exceptions may apply [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec02-F04 | anchor: A01
When the name on your identity document differs from your application, you must add a legal full name document proving your current name [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec02-F05 | anchor: A01
A social security number is required as well, with exceptions possible [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec02-F06 | anchor: A01
Current REAL ID document rules and eligibility are posted at dmv.ca.gov/realid [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec02-F07 | anchor: A01
Voter registration runs through the California Secretary of State at sos.ca.gov [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec02-F08 | anchor: A01
A Class C permit starts with a completed Driver's License & ID Card Application [A01].
Why it matters: the application form is the gateway step before documents, fees, and tests.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec02-F09 | anchor: A01
Next you hand over your documents and pay a non-refundable application fee [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec02-F10 | anchor: A01
Then you must pass your knowledge test or tests plus a vision test [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec02-F11 | anchor: A01
The full permit steps and requirements list lives at dmv.ca.gov/instructionpermit [A01].
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0008]

FACT_ID: sec02-F12 | anchor: A02
Applicants under eighteen must be at least fifteen and a half years old for a permit [A02].
Why it matters: the half-year minimum is the most-missed teen threshold.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-F13 | anchor: A02
Those minors must also finish a driver education program [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-F14 | anchor: A02
A parent or guardian must sign the minor's application, accepting financial responsibility, and both parents must sign under joint custody [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-F15 | anchor: A02
The minor may not use the permit until behind-the-wheel training begins with an instructor who validates it [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-F16 | anchor: A02
Driver education and training come from DMV-licensed driving schools and some high schools, whose instructors must carry an instructor ID card you should ask to see [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-F17 | anchor: A02
Guidance on choosing a driving school sits at dmv.ca.gov/driver-ed [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-F18 | anchor: A02
Permit practice needs a California-licensed driver at least eighteen years old, or twenty-five for minors, sitting close enough to seize control [A02].
Why it matters: the supervisor age split between adults and minors is heavily tested.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-F19 | anchor: A02
After the permit, the license itself still requires passing a behind-the-wheel drive test [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-F20 | anchor: A02
Minors must be at least sixteen years old to move from permit to license [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-F21 | anchor: A02
They must also have held an instruction permit for at least six months, from California or another state, or else turn eighteen before booking the drive test [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-F22 | anchor: A02
They must prove they finished both driver education and driver training [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-F23 | anchor: A02
They must log at least fifty practice hours with a California-licensed driver aged twenty-five or more, including ten hours at night [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-F24 | anchor: A02
Teen steps, requirements, the Parent Teen Driving Contract, and the Driving Performance Evaluation (DPE) Score Sheet are collected at dmv.ca.gov/teendriver [A02].
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0009]

FACT_ID: sec02-F25 | anchor: A03
Licenses issued before age eighteen carry the word provisional [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec02-F26 | anchor: A03
A provisional driver may not drive between eleven p.m. and five a.m. during the first twelve months of licensure [A03].
Why it matters: the night window plus the twelve-month clock form one compound rule.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec02-F27 | anchor: A03
Nor may they carry passengers under twenty unless a parent, guardian, or California-licensed driver at least twenty-five years old rides along [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec02-F28 | anchor: A03
Provisional drivers may not drive for pay nor operate vehicles needing a commercial Class A, B, or C license [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec02-F29 | anchor: A03
A medical-need exception requires a physician-signed note in the car stating the condition and the expected recovery date [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec02-F30 | anchor: A03
School driving needs a note signed by the principal, dean, or designee [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec02-F31 | anchor: A03
Work driving needs an employer-signed note confirming the employment [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec02-F32 | anchor: A03
Driving an immediate family member needs a parent or guardian-signed note naming the reason, the member, and the end date [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]

FACT_ID: sec02-F33 | anchor: A03
A parent or guardian can cancel a teen's license by filing a Request for Cancellation or Surrender of a Driver License or ID Card form [A03].
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ca-c:california-department-of-motor-vehicles:handbook:pdf-0010]
